column1: # THE SEVEN PRE-EXISTING PRODUCTION POLYC AUTHORITIES, RE-PROVED
# FROM THE CURRENT OBJECTS AND THE CURRENT EXECUTABLE.
#   - the symbol is DEFINED exactly ONCE in the executable;
#   - the subject object DEFINES it (the provider);
#   - the production caller object IMPORTS it (and does not define it)
#   - the legacy C decision is COMPILED OUT of the production object.
